title: How long is Sam Darnold out? Injury update with Seahawks QB set to miss Week 2

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: How long is Sam Darnold out? Injury update with Seahawks QB set to miss Week 2
sources.description: The Seahawks have already ruled Sam Darnold out for their Week 2 game against the Cardinals, but his glute injury isn't expected to keep him out long.
